facts.claim: The Vehar reservoir supplies about 8,000,000 gallons of water per day to Bombay.
facts.quote: The quantity of the water supplied by the reservoir is about 8,000,000 gallons a day, or a little more than 10 gallons per head for the population of Bombay.

facts.claim: The cost of constructing the Vehar reservoir and its pipelines to Bombay was over 37 lakhs.
facts.quote: The cost of the Vehar reservoir, and of laying the pipes into Bombay, was over 37 lakhs.

facts.claim: A new scheme in 1877 brought an independent main from the TulsI reservoir to Malabar Hill at a cost of 33 lakhs.
facts.quote: In 1877 a new scheme was undertaken for bringing an independent main from TulsI to the top of Malabar Hill in Bombay, which was carried out at a cost of 33 lakhs.
